Data Analyst — Operations Team

We are hiring a Data Analyst to join our operations team and help us make
better data-driven decisions across our business units.

What You Will Do
- Analyze large datasets to uncover business insights and trends
- Build dashboards and visualizations using Tableau or Power BI
- Write complex SQL queries to extract and transform data from our data warehouse
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to define KPIs and metrics
- Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for management

What We Look For
- Proficiency in SQL and data manipulation
- Experience with Excel for data analysis and pivot tables
- Familiarity with Python for data processing (pandas, numpy)
- Experience with Tableau or Power BI for visualization
- Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking

Bonus
- Knowledge of dbt for data transformation
- Exposure to Google BigQuery or Snowflake

Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience.
Apply via our careers page.
